descriptions.description: Speak Business English Like an American

exercises.title: Choose the most appropriate response to the following:

question.text: 1. Please don't try to talk me into exhibiting at your trade show this year.

options.option: Okay, I'll sign you up.
Okay, I'll call you tomorrow to talk about it some more.
Okay, if you're not interested, I won't ask again.

question.text: 2. I can't find Sam's address anywhere. Do you think you can help me track it down?

options.option: Yes, I'd be happy to track it.
Sure, I'll help you find it.
No, but I'll help you find it.

question.text: 3. We've already shelled out enough on advertising this year.

options.option: I agree. Let's spend more.
I know we've spent a lot, but I think we should do a couple more ads.
I disagree. We've already spent a lot of money on advertising.

question.text: 4. You think you'll be accepted to Harvard Business School? Dream on!

options.option: You may not agree, but I think it's a realistic goal.
Right, I'll just go to sleep and dream about it.
Thanks for helping me think big.

question.text: 5. I had nothing to do with the disastrous decision to hire Dan. Don’t point the finger at me!

options.option: I'm not pointing the finger, but I am blaming you.
Good. I'm glad you're willing to take the blame.
Okay, I won't blame you.

question.text: 6. I think we've struck gold with our idea to sell content on our website instead of giving it away for free. What do you think?

options.option: I agree. It's a great idea.
I agree. Nobody's going to be willing to pay for it.
I agree. We should sell silver and bronze on the site too.

question.text: 7. You need to take responsibility for our accounting problems. Stop trying to pass the buck!

options.option: Okay, I won't pass it anymore. You can have it.
I already passed the buck.
I'm not trying to pass the buck. I admit I made a mistake.

question.text: 8. You finally got promoted, and now you're leaving your company and opening a health food store? I can't believe my ears!

options.option: Yes, I know it's a surprising move.
I couldn't believe my ears either.
I know you're not surprised.
